Request Details
Subject
Inquiry regarding setting the "Position" field via submit_expense_report API
Details

Hi Workday suppor team

I am working on integrating our system with Workday using the submit_expense_report Web Service API.



I have a question regarding the "Position" field in the expense report. I need to specify this field via the API, as the selected position directly impacts the Business Process routing.





I have reviewed the API reference documentation below, but I could not find the specific field or parameter to map the Position:

https://community.workday.com/sites/default/files/file-hosting/productionapi/Resource_Management/v46.0/Submit_Expense_Report.html#Expense_Report_Line_WWS_DataType(opens in a new tab)



Could you please advise on how to correctly specify the "Position" in the Expense_Report_WWS_DataType? If there is a specific field or an alternative approach to set the position for the report, please let me know.



Thank you for your assistance.



Best regards,
